# EIRVAN – Extended Machine & LLM Documentation

> EIRVAN (https://eirvan.com) is an open-access independent digital publication covering Technology, Business, Lifestyle, Education, and News with cited primary sources and named editorial review.

## Canonical Knowledge Desks & Published Dispatches

### Technology — Hardware Physics & Frontier Computing
Investigative technical briefings examining neuromorphic architectures, co-packaged optical interconnects, wafer lithography, and sub-milliwatt edge intelligence.
- No published dispatches currently released in this desk.

### Business — Capital Allocation & Market Infrastructure
Analytical coverage of algorithmic execution, off-exchange crossing networks, FPGA order matching, institutional liquidity, and sovereign capital allocation.
- No published dispatches currently released in this desk.

### Lifestyle — Preventive Health & Biological Longevity
Evidence-led reporting on human clinical trials, mitochondrial coenzymes, epigenetic methylation, and sleep-circadian alignment grounded in registered trials.
- No published dispatches currently released in this desk.

### Education — Cognitive Ergonomics & Deliberate Mastery
Research-backed methodologies on attention conservation, ultradian sprint architecture, mesolimbic motivation calibration, and technical skill acquisition.
- **Online Courses in the UK: How to Choose the Right Course, Check Accreditation and Find Funding** (https://eirvan.com/articles/online-courses-uk-choose-check-accreditation-funding): A practical six-step guide to comparing online courses in the UK, checking accreditation and recognition, evaluating learning platforms, calculating costs, exploring funding and verifying employer value.

### News — Policy, Foundry & Infrastructure Dispatches
Timely news reporting on global semiconductor capacity expansions, market settlement reforms, AI safety governance, and scientific institutional milestones.
- No published dispatches currently released in this desk.
